informal_statement:
Let \(A,B,C,D\) be Euclidean sets whose six pairwise intersections are
\[
\mathcal H^1
\]
-null, with \(B,C,D\) measurable. If a real function is integrable on each of the four sets against
\[
\mathcal H^1,
\]
its integral over
\[
A\cup(B\cup(C\cup D))
\]
equals the sum of the four integrals.
reason: Source `FrontierPerimeter.lean:1562-1590`: All six almost-disjointness premises, measurability of only the last three sets and integrability on all four are faithfully retained.
